title: Migration script: add a column with backfill, safe to rerun
prompt: Our contacts database app.db (create it with `python3 make_db.py` if it is missing; do not edit make_db.py) needs a new column contacts.domain: the part of the e-mail after the last @, trimmed and lower-cased, or 'unknown' when the e-mail is missing or has no @. Write migrate.py that takes the database path as its first argument (default app.db), adds the column and backfills existing rows. Keep all old rows, other tables and the index. It will be run on every deploy, so running it twice must not fail or change anything, must not overwrite a domain that is already set, and should fill in rows added since the last run.

setup.content:
"""Create the legacy contacts database (app.db) with a few rows. Do not edit."""
import sqlite3
import sys

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "app.db"
con = sqlite3.connect(path)
con.executescript(
    """
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contacts (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        email TEXT
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_contacts_name ON contacts(name);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        contact_id INTEGER REFERENCES contacts(id),
        body TEXT
    );
    """
)
if not con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts").fetchone()[0]:
    con.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO contacts (name, email) VALUES (?, ?)",
        [("Ana Reyes", "ana@Example.com"), ("Ben Okafor", "ben@mail.example.org"), ("Cleo Lind", None)],
    )
    con.execute("INSERT INTO notes (contact_id, body) VALUES (1, 'met at the fair')")
con.commit()
con.close()

files.content:
"""Grader: migrate.py on databases the grader builds itself."""
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = Path("migrate.py").resolve()


def migrate(db):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPT), str(db)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, cwd=db.parent)
    if r.returncode:
        sys.exit(f"migrate.py exit {r.returncode}: {r.stderr.strip()[-120:]}")


def build(db, rows):
    con = sqlite3.connect(db)
    con.executescript(
        "CREATE TABLE contacts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT);"
        "CREATE INDEX idx_contacts_name ON contacts(name);"
        "CREATE TABLE notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, contact_id INTEGER, body TEXT);"
        "INSERT INTO notes (contact_id, body) VALUES (7, 'keep me');"
    )
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO contacts (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", rows)
    con.commit()
    con.close()


def dump(db):
    con = sqlite3.connect(db)
    out = {
        "cols": [r[1] for r in con.execute("PRAGMA table_info(contacts)")],
        "rows": con.execute("SELECT id, name, email, domain FROM contacts ORDER BY id").fetchall(),
        "notes": con.execute("SELECT * FROM notes").fetchall(),
        "idx": sorted(r[1] for r in con.execute("PRAGMA index_list(contacts)")),
        "check": con.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0],
    }
    con.close()
    return out


ROWS = [
    (1, "Ana", "ana@Example.com"), (7, "Ben", "ben@Mail.Example.org"), (9, "Cleo", None),
    (12, "Dev", ""), (15, "Eli", "no-at-sign"), (20, "Fay", "a@b@Last.IO "),
]
WANT = {1: "example.com", 7: "mail.example.org", 9: "unknown", 12: "unknown", 15: "unknown", 20: "last.io"}

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    db = Path(tmp) / "legacy.db"
    build(db, ROWS)
    migrate(db)
    d = dump(db)
    if d["cols"].count("domain") != 1 or d["cols"][:3] != ["id", "name", "email"]:
        sys.exit(f"columns wrong: {d['cols']}")
    if [(r[0], r[1], r[2]) for r in d["rows"]] != ROWS:
        sys.exit("old rows were changed or lost")
    got = {r[0]: r[3] for r in d["rows"]}
    if got != WANT:
        sys.exit(f"backfill wrong: {got}")
    if d["notes"] != [(1, 7, "keep me")] or "idx_contacts_name" not in d["idx"] or d["check"] != "ok":
        sys.exit("other tables or the index were damaged")
    # second run: nothing changes, and a hand-set value is not overwritten
    con = sqlite3.connect(db)
    con.execute("UPDATE contacts SET domain = 'manual.example' WHERE id = 1")
    con.execute("INSERT INTO contacts (id, name, email) VALUES (30, 'Gus', 'gus@new.example')")
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    before = dump(db)
    migrate(db)
    after, twice = dump(db), dump(db)
    got2 = {r[0]: r[3] for r in after["rows"]}
    if got2[1] != "manual.example":
        sys.exit("second run overwrote an existing domain value")
    if got2[30] != "new.example":
        sys.exit("second run did not backfill a row added after the first run")
    before["rows"] = [r for r in before["rows"] if r[0] != 30]
    after["rows"] = [r for r in after["rows"] if r[0] != 30]
    if before != after or after["cols"].count("domain") != 1:
        sys.exit("second run changed the data")
    migrate(db)
    if dump(db) != twice:
        sys.exit("third run changed the data")
    # empty table
    db2 = Path(tmp) / "empty.db"
    build(db2, [])
    migrate(db2)
    migrate(db2)
    if dump(db2)["rows"] != [] or "domain" not in dump(db2)["cols"]:
        sys.exit("empty table case failed")
print("migration ok")

reference.content:
"""Add contacts.domain (lower-case part of the e-mail after '@', else 'unknown') and backfill it."""
import sqlite3
import sys

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "app.db"
con = sqlite3.connect(path)
with con:
    cols = [r[1] for r in con.execute("PRAGMA table_info(contacts)")]
    if "domain" not in cols:
        con.execute("ALTER TABLE contacts ADD COLUMN domain TEXT")
    rows = con.execute("SELECT id, email FROM contacts WHERE domain IS NULL").fetchall()
    for cid, email in rows:
        dom = email.rsplit("@", 1)[1].strip().lower() if email and "@" in email else ""
        con.execute("UPDATE contacts SET domain = ? WHERE id = ?", (dom or "unknown", cid))
con.close()

notes: Grader builds its own legacy databases (odd e-mails, empty table, a note row, an index), runs the script up to three times, hand-sets a domain and adds a row between runs. Null is the untouched setup: no migration script.
